text: Here's a website we built for a nutrition coach who helps people on GLP-1 medications. Watch how it turns a visitor into a booked call.
The first screen says exactly who it's for, and gives two clear next steps: book a free call, or take a two-minute check.
Visitors tap the problem that sounds like their week, and get a plain answer, plus a button to work on it with a coach.
The Plate Check is the lead magnet. Seven quick questions, one at a time.
Every visitor gets a score, their three weakest areas, and the plan that fits. One button carries all of it into the booking form.
Then it builds trust, by naming the red flags this coach will never sell.
Four simple steps show what happens after the call.
Prices sit right on the page, and each plan opens a week-by-week outline, with its own booking button.
Visitors see what they'll take home, and meet the coach.
Not ready to book? A free protein guide still captures their name and email.
Straight answers clear up the last doubts.
And every path leads to one short booking form.
Step one: where they are, and their main concern.
Skip something, and it points to exactly what's missing.
Step two: their goals, in a few taps.
Step three: contact details, and the best time to talk.
Then a review screen, with their Plate Check score already attached.
One click, and the request is in, with clear next steps.
Want a website that turns visitors into booked calls? Talk to Delta Web.
